summary: Today's briefing focuses on significant legal rulings and developments in the retail sector, highlighting consumer rights and corporate expansions.

bullets.text: Bengaluru court awarded ₹3.78 crore to a whistleblower terminated by Willis Towers Watson.
J&K High Court ruled that pre-2019 consumer claims above ₹50 lakh are maintainable before the State Commission.
AU Small Finance Bank's Q2 profit surged 53% to ₹858 crore, with gross NPA ratio at 1.99%.
Reliance Consumer launched Joyland Dairy Drinks, expanding its FMCG portfolio.
Government extended the aluminium can certification deadline to April 2027, benefiting beverage manufacturers.
